facts.fact: The World Bank ISR reports 17 users with signed agreements with the Social Registry as of March 2025 (baseline 7 in July 2020), out of at least 25 governmental and non-governmental users, including Elmaouna, WFP, UNHCR and UNICEF, using it to select beneficiaries.

The World Bank ISR reports that, in a civil-registration pilot, the government signed a convention between the Social Registry and ANRPTS, the civil registry agency, with enrollment support under way.
